# mbedTLS (vendored subset)

TLS/X.509/crypto backend for picoquic via picotls. Upstream:
https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls — Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

- Version: `v3.6.7`
- Subset: `include/` (public headers) + `library/*.c,*.h` (all 109
  sources plus the private headers they include). Default
  `mbedtls_config.h` (TLS 1.3, PSA crypto, ECDSA, X.509 all on).
- Deliberately excluded: `programs/`, `tests/`, `3rdparty/` (no everest:
  no X25519/Ed25519; ECDSA P-256 + secp256r1 ECDHE suffice and match the
  existing Go transport's ECDSA profile), `scripts/`, `configs/`.

## Build

Per-file shims in `clients/go/bindings/picoquic/qp_mbed_*.c`, generated by
`clients/go/tools/gen_pq_shims.sh` (see `deps/picoquic/README.md`). Single-TU
amalgamation is impossible here (same-named file-scope statics collide
across sources, e.g. `FSb` in `aes.c` and `camellia.c`).

## Updating

1. Download the new mbedtls release tarball.
2. Replace `include/` and `library/`.
3. Regenerate shims, rebuild, run the loopback smoke test (N1 gate).
4. Update the version line above.
